description: Multi-hop pattern with mixed outgoing and incoming relationship directions.

source.scenario: [15] Mixing directed and undirected pattern parts with self-relationship, simple

sqlpgq.reason: PostgreSQL 19 SQL/PGQ uses WALK traversal semantics and returns 4 rows because it allows r1 and r2 to bind to the same edge, whereas openCypher trail semantics enforces relationship uniqueness.
